Egg coffee and salted coffee are simply out of this world!
Jul 2026 • Couples
If you are in Ho Chi Minh City, this place is an absolutely mandatory stop to try real Vietnamese coffee in unique and delicious variations!
We tried both the egg coffee and the salted coffee, and both were something fantastic and spectacular. The egg one is served hot and has a creaminess and an incredible flavor that is very reminiscent of tiramisu. The salted one, served cold with ice, is simply out of this world.
In keeping with the excellent tradition in Vietnam, they also offered us iced tea to accompany our stop, a small gesture of hospitality that is always much appreciated.
The place is really very beautiful, well-kept, and pleasant to stop in. Truly the best, both for the location and for the extraordinary quality of the coffees. Highly recommended!
